Author: FLYBYME <mangoraft@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon Sep 7 01:13:34 2026 -0400

    Collections follow the session (FLYBYME/surfdns#40)
    
    A collection (`models`) must react to the session:
    1. Reload on session arrival: When the session transitions from absent to
       present, a collection that previously failed for want of one (HTTP 401
       unauthorized) reloads automatically.
    2. Clear rows on sign-out: When the session transitions from present to
       absent, the collection immediately clears data and rows (`data: undefined`,
       `rows: []`, `status: 'idle'`). This eliminates data leaks between sessions
       and avoids displaying another user's rows after sign-out.
    3. User switching: When user switches (User A -> User B), rows for User A are
       immediately cleared and rows for User B are fetched.
    4. Suppress failing calls & Seam for #39: When a collection fails for auth
       and the session is absent, `shouldFetch()` returns false on query signal
       changes, avoiding spamming calls certain to fail while leaving a clean seam
       for `ExposureDescriptor.gate` (FLYBYME/surfdns#39). Explicit `refetch()`
       bypasses this suppression.
    5. In-flight 401 race handling: If an unauthenticated request returns 401 while
       a session arrived in the meantime, it triggers an immediate reload with the
       new session.
    6. Manifest session declaration: Applications can declare `session?: 'required' | 'optional'`,
       distinct from `consumes(AUTH)`. Manifest records this in `manifest.sessions`.
    7. Zero auth dependencies for unauthenticated sites: A site without `AuthExtension`
       boots cleanly and loads public collections without auth dependencies.
    
    Bump kernel patch version 0.15.2 -> 0.15.3 in package.json and mesh.json.
    
    — frank

   failedForAuth === false , so it will not load when the session arrives

  A session arriving should load every collection that has no data, whether it

  ## And the refresh buttons should not exist                                 
                                                                              
  "there should be no refresh button right? it should just be automatic? like 
  if                                                                          
  im viewing the partVersion collection and something on the server updated a 
  record im looking at, the ui should automatically capture the               
  partVersion.updated event and update the ui."                               
                                                                              
  Correct, and the pieces are all built:                                      
                                                                              
  •  defineCrud  generates  created / updated / deleted  events per collection
  —                                                                           
  they are in  src/generated/events.ts  and have been from the beginning      
  • a site declares which events it streams, with a gate on each              
  • the API already streams them to a browser over  /events                   
  •  api/methods/delivery.ts  narrows each event to the subscriber's scope,   
  and                                                                         
  an event that cannot be scoped is delivered to nobody                       
                                                                              
  Nothing subscribes.  cx.models('partVersion')  fetches once and then waits  
  to                                                                          
  be asked again, which is why every console has a Refresh button — a button  
  that                                                                        
  exists because the live path was never wired, not because anybody wanted    
  one.                                                                        
                                                                              
  A collection should subscribe to its own domain's events and apply them:    
  insert                                                                      
  on created, replace on updated, drop on deleted. Reconnect must resync      
  rather                                                                      
  than assume the gap was empty — the mesh delivers at-most-once and a dropped
  event is silent.                                                            


FLYBYME (Owner) • 17m • Newest comment

  Plan for #56:                                                               
                                                                              
  ### What I Found                                                            
                                                                              
  • Defect 1a (Blind firing):  shouldFetch()  only suppresses after receiving 
  a 401. With  ApiCall.gate  now present at runtime, gated endpoints can be   
  checked upfront so requests needing a session do not fire blind.            
  • Defect 1b (Dead session effect): When auth has not yet published a        
  session,  getSessionSignal()  returns undefined and the effect exits having 
  read nothing reactive. It registers 0 dependencies and never runs again on  
  sign-in.                                                                    
  • Defect 1c (Held-back refetch): Refetch on session arrival was gated on    
  failedForAuth . A collection held back by gate check never failed, so it    
  would never load on sign-in.                                                
  • Live collections: Collections fetch once without listening to  /events    
  SSE stream for domain CRUD events ( created ,  updated ,  deleted ), forcing
  manual refresh.                                                             
                                                                              
  ### What I Will Change                                                      
                                                                              
  • Item 1: Session & Gate Awareness                                          
                                                                              
  • Check  ApiCall.gate  in  shouldFetch() : decline initial fetch if auth    
  required and session absent; set status to  'idle' .                        
  • Provide a reactive session signal in  KernelServices  so the session      
  effect in  CollectionQueryImpl  always subscribes to reactive state at      
  construction time.                                                          
  • On session arrival ( absent -> present ), refetch any collection with no  
  data ( _data() === undefined || failedForAuth ).                            
  • Maintain data-leak protections: clear rows on sign-out and switch-user.

  • Connect collection to SSE event stream ( /events ) for its domain ( <name>.

  • On stream reconnect, resync ( refetch() ) to recover from at-most-once
